findings.reason: recording ambix's gs/ as a distinguished non-reuse would complete the mandated prior-art record but would not alter any of the four signatures, the acceptance table or a done-when.
findings.text: the plan's §4 proposes gs.apply as nova's Grad-Shafranov forward operator but its reuse map, exhaustive over nova, never cites imas-ambix, the coupled repo whose gs/ package already holds a forward GS operator (operator.py, residual.py, grounding.py) — the nearest prior art is in fact a distinct object (a sensor-space linear soft-prior map G_pf·I_pf + G_plasma·c_plasma on a limiter-masked grid, whose own docstring records that solving belongs to the solver, and which imports nothing from nova), not the nonlinear ψ = ψ_ext + G·J(ψ) fixed-point map the plan builds

reuse_search-1.reason: plan comment c-s21-gs-apply-ambix-scout on section 4 (plan version 94, commit 6c46324c9) records the imas-ambix search: gs/operator.py is a linear sensor-space soft-prior map and is not reused by gs.apply

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — four modules (topology.read, current.book, gs.apply, solve.fixed_point) each hide substantial behaviour behind a single narrow function, replacing the 54-file/54k-line sprawl and the 17 null-role and 23 region-role scattered authorities.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — every duplicate-prone mechanism names the owner to extend rather than fork: constraint.py:1843 (row scale), polygon_moments.py (polygon integration), contour_tree.py (the tree), nova/database/filepath.py:175 (receipt placement), scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_guard.py (compile count), solve_request.py (policy and receipt).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2–§5 each name the mechanism they replace, §5 lands SolvePolicy inside ForwardSolvePolicy rather than beside it, and §6 records the ForwardSolvePolicy before/after field counts plus the SolveRoute (six→one, solve_request.py:27) and SupportClipMode (three→one, solve_request.py:35) collapses as the accounting the zero-count claim rests on.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan's reuse map over nova is exhaustive (every named candidate verified at its stated home, ~40 symbols) but it cites no search of imas-ambix, the coupled repo the repo AGENTS.md requires be scouted in both directions before authoring new machinery.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — each proposed module is stated as a replacement of a named mechanism, not a layer over it: §2 replaces Topology.read and read_with_connectivity, §3 replaces clipped_support_current_moments (clip_quadrature.py:714) and the support partition in forward_operator.py, §4 "replaces the map ForwardFluxOperator performs today rather than wrapping it", §5 replaces newton_krylov (fixed_point.py:5003), picard (fixed_point.py:2874) and operator_request_body; the retained forward.py is justified as the request/receipt adapter.
